name: 3D Texture Generation via Slicing
aliases: GPU Voxelization via Clip Planes and Framebuffers
definition: Generates a 3D texture by rendering 2D slices of a scene to a 2D texture, reading pixels, and assembling them into a 3D texture.
summary: 3D Texture Generation via Slicing builds voxel volumes by rendering mesh slices with a moving clip plane and copying them to a 3D texture, differing from other methods by using multiple draw calls per slice.
